auth.title: Duxtur Edu
auth.subtitle: Sign in to access your dashboard
auth.tg_instructions_3: 3. Come back here — you will be signed in automatically.
auth.error_expired: The Telegram link expired. Please try again.
auth.error_failed: Telegram sign-in failed. Open Diagnostics below for details.
auth.duxtur_first_time: This creates your Edu profile from your duxtur.org account. Already used Edu with Telegram or Google? Sign in that way and link duxtur.org in your profile instead.
auth.duxtur_failed: Could not sign in with duxtur.org.

account.title: Sign-in methods
account.intro: One person, one account. Link your duxtur.org account to sign in to both with the same profile.
account.not_signed_in: You are not signed in to duxtur.org in this browser.
account.linkable: You are signed in to duxtur.org as {{name}}. This account is not linked to an Edu account yet.
account.link_confirm_body: Your Edu account ({{method}}) will be linked to the duxtur.org account {{name}} ({{email}}). From now on "Continue as" on the sign-in page opens this Edu profile, with its groups and results. You can unlink at any time.
account.linked_elsewhere: {{name}} on duxtur.org is already linked to another Edu account, so it cannot be linked to this one. Sign in to Edu with duxtur.org to open that account and unlink it there.
account.unlink_confirm_body: Signing in with duxtur.org will no longer open this Edu profile. Its groups and results stay in it, and you can still sign in the way you do now.

errors.not_signed_in: You are not signed in to duxtur.org. Sign in there and try again.
errors.bad_origin: The request was refused. Open Edu from a duxtur.org page.
errors.invalid_id_token: Your Edu sign-in could not be verified. Sign out of Edu, sign in again and retry.
errors.edu_uid_taken: This Edu account is already linked to another duxtur.org account.
errors.portal_already_linked: This duxtur.org account already has another Edu account linked. Unlink that one first.
errors.invalid_uid: This Edu account cannot be linked.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute.
errors.network: Cannot reach duxtur.org. Check your connection.
errors.server: duxtur.org is unavailable right now. Try again later.
errors.bad_response: duxtur.org sent an unexpected answer. Try again later.
errors.cannot_unlink: This Edu profile can only be reached through duxtur.org, so it cannot be unlinked.

account.cannot_unlink: This Edu profile was created from your duxtur.org account, so duxtur.org is its only way to sign in and it cannot be unlinked.
